name: Zarzuela del Monte (Spain)
description: Square flag of three vertical stripes of green, white and green, the white charged with the crowned municipal arms of Zarzuela del Monte (three ears of wheat on green within a bordure of brambles).
history: Zarzuela del Monte adopted its arms and flag officially on 14 February 2003, published in the Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León on 2 June 2003; the flag is a square cloth of proportion 1:1 divided into three equal vertical stripes, the central white charged with the arms.
